positive_snippets: The stay here is worth it the staff is very polite and cooperative. The food is also great and i would highly reccomend this to everyone .
negative_snippets:
Very disappointing stay. The room floor was dirty, no towels were provided, and the TV didn’t work. The room was extremely cold, and when I complained, they charged ₹200 for a tiny heater that didn’t even work. They also charged ₹500 extra to switch rooms, but the new room was no better.
The mattress was in terrible condition and caused serious back pain. Staff was unprofessional and unhelpful throughout. I wish I could give 0 stars.

Not so good experience. Female at reseption was so rude. Don book breakfast with room because they have only pranta and poha in morning menu. Overall very bad experience . Even they don't have printed Bills
The place looked nice, but there were no towels, soaps, or even hot water. The bucket and mug were dirty, and the service was poor. FabHotels’ customer support was also disappointing.
